messages:
Marta: Quick capture from this week's onboarding calls — consolidated signal for product. TL;DR: three recurring asks + onboarding friction. I'll paste a tiny table.

Devon: Thanks — can you include frequency (how many accounts) and severity? we'll need to prioritize.

Marta: Sure. Rough counts: 6 accounts asked for feature A (per-route billing export), 4 asked for B (per-route quota visibility), 8 flagged C (embed/latency concerns), and onboarding issue: 3 had trouble with service account KMS integration.

Nina: adding context — the 8 latency flags are all high-usage customers on dedicated; they see 200–600ms extra p99 for embeddings when payloads > 512 tokens.

Sahil: That matches runtime traces — KV-cache warmups + second-tier model fallbacks. Could be routing policy.

Marta: Raw list (paste):

```
- Per-route CSV export for billing (6 accounts) — want per-customer per-route rows, timezone, cost fields
- Route-level quota & alerting (4 accounts) — they'd like per-route quotas and Slack/email alerts
- Embedding latency spikes >512 tokens (8 accounts) — requests for faster batching heuristics or async results
- KMS onboarding friction (3 accounts) — service account role docs unclear, fails at key unwrap step
```

Devon: Ok. My take: KMS docs fix is quick. Per-route CSV export is medium effort (db + export UX). Embedding perf needs infra + runtime work — high cost but high impact for renewals. Let's mark severity accordingly.

Marta: Proposed prioritization tags for product board: quick-win, medium, heavy. Assigns: KMS -> quick-win, CSV export -> medium, Embedding perf -> heavy.

Devon: Agree. Nina — can you confirm which of the 6 CSV-asks are in renewal window (next 90d)?

Nina: Yep — 2 of them are Q2 renewals, 1 flagged health risk. I'll DM details. :eyes:

product-bot: Created GitHub issue #PROD-1298 for "KMS onboarding docs — step fixes" (link: https://git.company/prod/1298)

Sahil: For embedding perf, I'll scope a short spike next sprint: outline steps -> benchmark current p99, try prefix caching and continuous batch size adjustment, estimate effort 2 wks.

Marta: Action items:
1) Nina -> DM renewal owners (by EOD)
2) Devon -> create ticket for CSV export with sample schema
3) Sahil -> spike plan for embedding perf
4) Marta -> update product board tags + attach call notes

Any objections? Please react with :+1: to confirm or comment.

Devon: +1

Sahil: +1

Nina: +1

Marta: thanks all — I'll update board and move to triage.
